components.name: Progress bar
components.description: Progress bar shows how far along a task, upload or course is. Linear only. Bind the bar width to the real percentage when composing screens. Size = S | M | L (size/progress/1·2·3 = 4 · 6 · 8) × Status = Neutral | Accent | Success | Warning | Danger = 15 variants. Indeterminate loading → _Spinner (9.1).
